Players Committee card image of [[Daroe (V) (ALT)]] (original printing), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. Information broker. When deployed, may deploy a droid here or a Restraining Bolt from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. During battle, may retarget an opponent's weapon targeting your droid to another one of your characters present (even Daroe).”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Dark/large/daroe_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/bf1d08e0b82f40b5422be00dcc4c3a781c1dbefd bf1d08e] (14 July 2023). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged (the repository file is named .gif but is PNG data, so it is uploaded with a .png name).
